description: xz-packaged wrapper for the context-6 LTO fx2-cmix no-dictionary package
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
notes: Same native no-dictionary binary bytes as fx2_struct_top_nodict_min_v1 after gzip decompression, stored as xz and invoked with cmix -c input output / cmix -d input output.

10m_inherited_from_fx2_struct_top_nodict.roundtrip_basis: Same decompressed native binary and same -c/-d arguments as the direct-verified parent, plus local 1KB roundtrip and deterministic archive gate.

verdict: Promote as the current best measured 10MB exact-S package. This is a packaging improvement only; it does not change the entropy model.
